snippet.title: Get the Fluff Out - Trailer
snippet.description:
Comfortable... Safe... Happy... Until...

Grab your friends, or your enemies, and race to the exit before the cave-in! Get the Fluff Out!

In this platformer racing game, play with an infinite amount of friends (or enemies) to see who can propel, swing, and fling to the exit! 

Features:
Propel, Swing, and Pull Opponents
Infinite Multiplayer
Spectator Mode
Powerups: Speed Boost, Power Jump, Death Grapple/Invulnerability

https://littlecopper.itch.io/get-the-fluff-out
